items.question: Trong câu "A simple tool used consistently beats a powerful one that gets avoided.", từ "consistently" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A simple tool used consistently beats a powerful one that gets avoided.", what does "consistently" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: consistently /kənˈsɪs.tənt.li/ (trạng từ): một cách đều đặn. "Used consistently" = được dùng đều đặn, lần nào cũng dùng. Tính từ: consistent (nhất quán).
items.explanationEn: consistently /kənˈsɪs.tənt.li/ (adverb): regularly, every time. "Used consistently" means used all the time, not now and then. Adjective: consistent.

items.question: Trong câu "A simple tool used consistently beats a powerful one that gets avoided.", từ "beat" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A simple tool used consistently beats a powerful one that gets avoided.", what does "beat" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: beat /biːt/ (động từ): tốt hơn, thắng. "X beats Y" = X tốt hơn Y. Một công cụ đơn giản được dùng thật sự tốt hơn công cụ mạnh bị né tránh.
items.explanationEn: beat /biːt/ (verb): to be better than. "X beats Y" means X is better; a simple tool in real use beats a powerful unused one.

items.question: Trong câu "Prefer integration over standalone features.", từ "integration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prefer integration over standalone features.", what does "integration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: integration /ˌɪn.tɪˈɡreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự tích hợp, kết nối. "Prefer integration over X" = ưu tiên các công cụ kết nối được với nhau. Động từ: integrate.
items.explanationEn: integration /ˌɪn.tɪˈɡreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): the joining of systems. "Prefer integration" means choosing tools that connect to each other. Verb: integrate.

items.question: Trong câu "Prefer integration over standalone features.", từ "standalone" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prefer integration over standalone features.", what does "standalone" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: standalone /ˈstænd.ə.ləʊn/ (tính từ): đứng riêng lẻ. "Standalone feature/tool" = tính năng/công cụ độc lập, không nối với hệ thống khác.
items.explanationEn: standalone /ˈstænd.ə.ləʊn/ (adjective): working on its own. A standalone tool works alone, without connecting to other systems.

items.question: Trong câu "Prefer integration over standalone features.", từ "prefer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Prefer integration over standalone features.", what does "prefer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prefer /prɪˈfɜːr/ (động từ): ưu tiên chọn. Cấu trúc: prefer A over/to B = thích/ưu tiên A hơn B. Danh từ: preference.
items.explanationEn: prefer /prɪˈfɜːr/ (verb): to choose first. Pattern: prefer A over (or to) B. Noun: preference.

items.question: Trong câu "A suite that talks to itself beats best-in-class tools that do not connect.", từ "suite" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A suite that talks to itself beats best-in-class tools that do not connect.", what does "suite" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: suite /swiːt/ (danh từ): bộ phần mềm. Phát âm /swiːt/ giống "sweet", khác "suit" /suːt/. "Office suite" = bộ ứng dụng văn phòng.
items.explanationEn: suite /swiːt/ (noun): a set of related programs. Pronounced like "sweet", not like "suit". An office suite is a set of office programs.

items.question: Trong câu "A suite that talks to itself beats best-in-class tools that do not connect.", từ "best-in-class" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A suite that talks to itself beats best-in-class tools that do not connect.", what does "best-in-class" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: best-in-class /ˌbest ɪn ˈklɑːs/ (tính từ): tốt nhất trong loại. "Best-in-class tools" = công cụ dẫn đầu từng hạng mục, nhưng nếu không kết nối với nhau thì kém hiệu quả.
items.explanationEn: best-in-class /ˌbest ɪn ˈklɑːs/ (adjective): top of its category. Best-in-class tools lead their category, but lose value if they don't connect.

items.question: Trong câu "Each copy is an opportunity to drift out of sync.", từ "drift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each copy is an opportunity to drift out of sync.", what does "drift" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to change slowly out of line
items.explanation: drift /drɪft/ (động từ): dần dần lệch đi. "Drift out of sync" = dần mất đồng bộ. Mỗi bản sao là một cơ hội để thông tin lệch nhau.
items.explanationEn: drift /drɪft/ (verb): to change slowly out of line. "Drift out of sync" means gradually stop matching; every copy invites it.

items.question: Trong câu "Do not let the tool dictate the process.", từ "dictate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Do not let the tool dictate the process.", what does "dictate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dictate /dɪkˈteɪt/ (động từ): áp đặt, quyết định. "Let the tool dictate the process" = để công cụ áp đặt cách làm việc. Nghĩa khác: đọc chính tả.
items.explanationEn: dictate /dɪkˈteɪt/ (verb): to control or impose. "Let the tool dictate the process" means letting it impose how you work. Other sense: to speak for someone to write down.

items.question: Trong câu "It does not elicit, clarify, detect gaps, or resolve stakeholder conflict.", từ "elicit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It does not elicit, clarify, detect gaps, or resolve stakeholder conflict.", what does "elicit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (động từ): khai thác, gợi ra. "Elicit requirements" = khai thác yêu cầu từ stakeholder. Đừng nhầm với illicit (bất hợp pháp).
items.explanationEn: elicit /iˈlɪs.ɪt/ (verb): to draw out information. "Elicit requirements" means drawing them out of stakeholders. Don't confuse it with illicit (illegal).

items.question: Trong câu "It does not elicit, clarify, detect gaps, or resolve stakeholder conflict.", từ "clarify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It does not elicit, clarify, detect gaps, or resolve stakeholder conflict.", what does "clarify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: clarify /ˈklær.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): làm rõ. "Clarify a requirement" = làm rõ yêu cầu. Danh từ: clarification; câu hay dùng: "Could you clarify...?"
items.explanationEn: clarify /ˈklær.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to make clear. "Clarify a requirement" means removing doubt. Noun: clarification; phrase: "Could you clarify...?"

items.question: Trong câu "It does not elicit, clarify, detect gaps, or resolve stakeholder conflict.", từ "gap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It does not elicit, clarify, detect gaps, or resolve stakeholder conflict.", what does "gap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gap /ɡæp/ (danh từ): chỗ còn thiếu sót. "Detect gaps" = phát hiện chỗ thiếu trong yêu cầu. Cụm: gap analysis (phân tích khoảng trống).
items.explanationEn: gap /ɡæp/ (noun): a missing part. "Detect gaps" means spotting what the requirements miss. Phrase: gap analysis.

items.question: Trong câu "It does not elicit, clarify, detect gaps, or resolve stakeholder conflict.", từ "resolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It does not elicit, clarify, detect gaps, or resolve stakeholder conflict.", what does "resolve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (động từ): giải quyết, hòa giải. "Resolve conflict" = giải quyết xung đột. Nghĩa khác: resolve to do (quyết tâm làm).
items.explanationEn: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (verb): to settle a problem. "Resolve conflict" means settle it. Other sense: resolve to do something (decide firmly).

items.question: Trong câu "An organization with weak analysis skills simply gets bad requirements organized more attractively.", từ "attractively" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An organization with weak analysis skills simply gets bad requirements organized more attractively.", what does "attractively" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: attractively /əˈtræk.tɪv.li/ (trạng từ): trông đẹp mắt hơn. Ý câu: công cụ chỉ làm yêu cầu tệ trông đẹp hơn, không làm chúng tốt hơn. Tính từ: attractive.
items.explanationEn: attractively /əˈtræk.tɪv.li/ (adverb): in a pleasing way. The point: tools make bad requirements look nicer, not better. Adjective: attractive.

items.question: Trong câu "every answer in a comment is a piece of context preserved permanently.", từ "preserve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "every answer in a comment is a piece of context preserved permanently.", what does "preserve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: preserve /prɪˈzɜːv/ (động từ): lưu giữ lại. "Context preserved permanently" = bối cảnh được lưu giữ lâu dài ngay trên issue.
items.explanationEn: preserve /prɪˈzɜːv/ (verb): to keep from being lost. "Context preserved permanently" means it stays on the issue for good.

items.question: Trong câu "Linking defects to their originating story to see which area is failing.", từ "originate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linking defects to their originating story to see which area is failing.", what does "originate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: originate /əˈrɪdʒ.ən.eɪt/ (động từ): bắt nguồn từ. "Originating story" = story gốc nơi lỗi phát sinh. Cụm: originate from/in.
items.explanationEn: originate /əˈrɪdʒ.ən.eɪt/ (verb): to start from. The "originating story" is the one the defect comes from. Pattern: originate from/in.

items.question: Trong câu "Linking defects to their originating story to see which area is failing.", từ "defect" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linking defects to their originating story to see which area is failing.", what does "defect" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (danh từ): lỗi, khiếm khuyết. Danh từ đọc /ˈdiː.fekt/; động từ /dɪˈfekt/ nghĩa là đào tẩu. Trong kiểm thử, defect ≈ bug.
items.explanationEn: defect /ˈdiː.fekt/ (noun): a fault in a product. The noun is stressed first; the verb /dɪˈfekt/ means to desert. In testing, defect ≈ bug.

items.question: Trong câu "A high-value practice few teams adopt: when commit messages reference the issue ID, the requirement-to-code link is created AUTOMATICALLY as a side effect of normal work.", từ "adopt" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A high-value practice few teams adopt: when commit messages reference the issue ID, the requirement-to-code link is created AUTOMATICALLY as a side effect of normal work.", what does "adopt" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: adopt /əˈdɒpt/ (động từ): áp dụng, làm theo. "A practice few teams adopt" = thói quen ít nhóm áp dụng. Đừng nhầm adopt với adapt (thích nghi).
items.explanationEn: adopt /əˈdɒpt/ (verb): to take up a practice. "A practice few teams adopt" means few take it up. Don't confuse adopt with adapt.

items.question: Trong câu "A high-value practice few teams adopt: when commit messages reference the issue ID, the requirement-to-code link is created AUTOMATICALLY as a side effect of normal work.", từ "side effect" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A high-value practice few teams adopt: when commit messages reference the issue ID, the requirement-to-code link is created AUTOMATICALLY as a side effect of normal work.", what does "side effect" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: side effect /ˈsaɪd ɪˌfekt/ (cụm từ): kết quả phụ đi kèm. "As a side effect of normal work" = như một kết quả tự nhiên đi kèm công việc bình thường. Nghĩa y khoa: tác dụng phụ.
items.explanationEn: side effect /ˈsaɪd ɪˌfekt/ (phrase): an extra result. "As a side effect of normal work" means it happens for free. Medical sense: a drug side effect.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most durable form of tracing — because it requires nobody to remember updating a separate table.", từ "durable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most durable form of tracing — because it requires nobody to remember updating a separate table.", what does "durable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: durable /ˈdjʊə.rə.bəl/ (tính từ): bền vững, lâu dài. "Durable form of tracing" = cách truy vết bền, không phụ thuộc trí nhớ ai. Nghĩa gốc: bền (hàng hóa).
items.explanationEn: durable /ˈdjʊə.rə.bəl/ (adjective): long-lasting. A durable form of tracing lasts because it depends on nobody's memory. Literal sense: hard-wearing goods.

items.question: Trong câu "Over-complicated configuration with twenty mandatory fields — people fill in anything to get past the form and the data becomes worthless.", từ "mandatory" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Over-complicated configuration with twenty mandatory fields — people fill in anything to get past the form and the data becomes worthless.", what does "mandatory" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tər.i/ (tính từ): bắt buộc. "Mandatory fields" = trường bắt buộc nhập. Trái nghĩa: optional.
items.explanationEn: mandatory /ˈmæn.də.tər.i/ (adjective): required. "Mandatory fields" must be filled in. Opposite: optional.

items.question: Trong câu "Over-complicated configuration with twenty mandatory fields — people fill in anything to get past the form and the data becomes worthless.", từ "worthless" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Over-complicated configuration with twenty mandatory fields — people fill in anything to get past the form and the data becomes worthless.", what does "worthless" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worthless /ˈwɜːθ.ləs/ (tính từ): vô giá trị. "The data becomes worthless" = dữ liệu trở nên vô dụng vì người ta điền bừa. Trái nghĩa: valuable.
items.explanationEn: worthless /ˈwɜːθ.ləs/ (adjective): of no value. "The data becomes worthless" because people type anything. Opposite: valuable.

items.question: Trong câu "Using Jira as a repository that is never queried, filtered, or reported on.", từ "repository" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Using Jira as a repository that is never queried, filtered, or reported on.", what does "repository" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: repository /rɪˈpɒz.ɪ.tər.i/ (danh từ): kho lưu trữ. "A repository" = nơi chứa thông tin; trong Git là kho mã (repo). Dùng Jira chỉ để chứa mà không truy vấn là lãng phí.
items.explanationEn: repository /rɪˈpɒz.ɪ.tər.i/ (noun): a storage place. A repository stores things; in Git it holds code. Using Jira only to store data wastes it.

items.question: Trong câu "Linking stories to epics to keep the bigger picture visible.", từ "the bigger picture" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Linking stories to epics to keep the bigger picture visible.", what does "the bigger picture" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: the bigger picture /ðə ˈbɪɡ.ər ˈpɪk.tʃər/ (cụm từ): bức tranh tổng thể. "Keep the bigger picture visible" = giữ cho thấy được toàn cảnh. Cụm: see the bigger picture.
items.explanationEn: the bigger picture /ðə ˈbɪɡ.ər ˈpɪk.tʃər/ (phrase): the overall situation. "Keep the bigger picture visible" means the overall view stays clear. Phrase: see the bigger picture.

items.question: Trong câu "The dividing principle: Jira for short-lived items tied to work; Confluence for what outlives the project.", từ "short-lived" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The dividing principle: Jira for short-lived items tied to work; Confluence for what outlives the project.", what does "short-lived" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: short-lived /ˌʃɔːtˈlɪvd/ (tính từ): tồn tại ngắn hạn. "Short-lived items" = mục chỉ tồn tại ngắn (story, bug trong sprint). Trái nghĩa: long-lived.
items.explanationEn: short-lived /ˌʃɔːtˈlɪvd/ (adjective): lasting a short time. Short-lived items like sprint stories don't last long. Opposite: long-lived.

items.question: Trong câu "The dividing principle: Jira for short-lived items tied to work; Confluence for what outlives the project.", từ "tied to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The dividing principle: Jira for short-lived items tied to work; Confluence for what outlives the project.", what does "tied to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: tied to /taɪd tuː/ (cụm từ): gắn liền với. "Items tied to work" = mục gắn với công việc đang chạy. Nghĩa đen: bị buộc vào; thể thao: tied = hòa.
items.explanationEn: tied to /taɪd tuː/ (phrase): closely linked to. "Items tied to work" are linked to active work. Literal sense: tied with rope; in sport, tied means level.

items.question: Trong câu "Four practices that keep Confluence useful rather than a dumping ground:", từ "dumping ground" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Four practices that keep Confluence useful rather than a dumping ground:", what does "dumping ground" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: dumping ground /ˈdʌm.pɪŋ ɡraʊnd/ (cụm từ): nơi vứt đồ lộn xộn. "Dumping ground" = bãi rác, nghĩa bóng là nơi đổ tài liệu bừa bãi không ai dọn. Động từ: dump (đổ bỏ).
items.explanationEn: dumping ground /ˈdʌm.pɪŋ ɡraʊnd/ (phrase): a place for unwanted stuff. Figuratively, a dumping ground is where content is thrown and never tidied. Verb: dump.

items.question: Trong câu "Delete or mark obsolete pages that are no longer correct.", từ "obsolete" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Delete or mark obsolete pages that are no longer correct.", what does "obsolete" (adjective) mean?
options: đã lỗi thời, hết hiệu lực
items.explanation: obsolete /ˈɒb.səl.iːt/ (tính từ): đã lỗi thời, hết hiệu lực. "Mark obsolete" = đánh dấu là lỗi thời để người đọc không tin vào nội dung sai.
items.explanationEn: obsolete /ˈɒb.səl.iːt/ (adjective): no longer in use. "Mark obsolete" flags a page as outdated so no one trusts it.

items.question: Trong câu "A page without an owner goes stale and nobody fixes it.", từ "stale" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A page without an owner goes stale and nobody fixes it.", what does "stale" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stale /steɪl/ (tính từ): cũ, không còn cập nhật. "Go stale" = trở nên cũ, lỗi thời. Nghĩa gốc: bánh mì, đồ ăn bị ôi.
items.explanationEn: stale /steɪl/ (adjective): out of date. "Go stale" means become outdated. Literal sense: bread going stale.

items.question: Trong câu "A clear folder structure with an index page for each area.", từ "index" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A clear folder structure with an index page for each area.", what does "index" (noun) mean?
options: chỉ mục cơ sở dữ liệu
items.explanation: index /ˈɪn.deks/ (danh từ): trang mục lục. "Index page" = trang mục lục dẫn tới các trang con. Số nhiều: indexes hoặc indices.
items.explanationEn: index /ˈɪn.deks/ (noun): a list of contents. An index page lists and links to child pages. Plural: indexes or indices.

items.question: Trong câu "Two-way links with Jira — the Confluence page references the relevant epic, and vice versa.", từ "vice versa" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two-way links with Jira — the Confluence page references the relevant epic, and vice versa.", what does "vice versa" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: vice versa /ˌvaɪs ˈvɜː.sə/ (cụm từ): và ngược lại. "And vice versa" = và ngược lại: trang Confluence trỏ tới epic, epic cũng trỏ về trang.
items.explanationEn: vice versa /ˌvaɪs ˈvɜː.sə/ (phrase): the other way round. "And vice versa" means the reverse is also true: the epic links back to the page.

items.question: Trong câu "Two-way links with Jira — the Confluence page references the relevant epic, and vice versa.", từ "relevant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two-way links with Jira — the Confluence page references the relevant epic, and vice versa.", what does "relevant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: relevant /ˈrel.ə.vənt/ (tính từ): có liên quan. "The relevant epic" = epic có liên quan. Trái nghĩa: irrelevant. Danh từ: relevance.
items.explanationEn: relevant /ˈrel.ə.vənt/ (adjective): connected to the matter. "The relevant epic" is the one that applies. Opposite: irrelevant. Noun: relevance.

items.question: Trong câu "Why dedicated modeling tools are worth considering on large projects:", từ "dedicated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why dedicated modeling tools are worth considering on large projects:", what does "dedicated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dedicated /ˈded.ɪ.keɪ.tɪd/ (tính từ): chuyên dụng. "Dedicated modeling tools" = công cụ chuyên cho mô hình hóa. Nghĩa khác: a dedicated employee (tận tụy).
items.explanationEn: dedicated /ˈded.ɪ.keɪ.tɪd/ (adjective): built for one purpose. "Dedicated modeling tools" exist only for modeling. Other sense: a dedicated (devoted) employee.

items.question: Trong câu "Why dedicated modeling tools are worth considering on large projects:", từ "worth" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why dedicated modeling tools are worth considering on large projects:", what does "worth" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: worth /wɜːθ/ (tính từ): đáng (để làm). "Be worth + V-ing" = đáng làm gì: worth considering (đáng cân nhắc). Nghĩa khác: worth $10 (trị giá).
items.explanationEn: worth /wɜːθ/ (adjective): deserving of. "Be worth + -ing" means deserving it: worth considering. Other sense: worth ten dollars.

items.question: Trong câu "They enforce each method's rules, catching syntax errors and inconsistencies a reviewer might miss.", từ "enforce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They enforce each method's rules, catching syntax errors and inconsistencies a reviewer might miss.", what does "enforce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (động từ): bắt buộc tuân thủ. "Enforce rules" = buộc tuân thủ quy tắc. Danh từ: enforcement (law enforcement = thực thi pháp luật).
items.explanationEn: enforce /ɪnˈfɔːs/ (verb): to make rules be obeyed. "Enforce rules" means making sure they are obeyed. Noun: enforcement.

items.question: Trong câu "They enforce each method's rules, catching syntax errors and inconsistencies a reviewer might miss.", từ "inconsistency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They enforce each method's rules, catching syntax errors and inconsistencies a reviewer might miss.", what does "inconsistency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: inconsistency /ˌɪn.kənˈsɪs.tən.si/ (danh từ): chỗ không nhất quán. "Inconsistencies" = những chỗ mâu thuẫn, không khớp giữa các sơ đồ. Tính từ: inconsistent.
items.explanationEn: inconsistency /ˌɪn.kənˈsɪs.tən.si/ (noun): a part that doesn't match. Inconsistencies are places where diagrams don't agree. Adjective: inconsistent.

items.question: Trong câu "They link several diagrams to each other and to the corresponding requirements.", từ "corresponding" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They link several diagrams to each other and to the corresponding requirements.", what does "corresponding" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: corresponding /ˌkɒr.ɪˈspɒn.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): tương ứng. "The corresponding requirements" = các yêu cầu tương ứng với sơ đồ. Động từ: correspond to.
items.explanationEn: corresponding /ˌkɒr.ɪˈspɒn.dɪŋ/ (adjective): matching or related. "The corresponding requirements" are those that match each diagram. Verb: correspond to.

items.question: Trong câu "They make it easy to iterate and refine — and you almost never draw it right the first time.", từ "refine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "They make it easy to iterate and refine — and you almost never draw it right the first time.", what does "refine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: refine /rɪˈfaɪn/ (động từ): tinh chỉnh dần. "Iterate and refine" = làm nhiều vòng và tinh chỉnh dần. Cụm: backlog refinement.
items.explanationEn: refine /rɪˈfaɪn/ (verb): to improve by small changes. "Iterate and refine" means improving in small rounds. Related: backlog refinement.

items.question: Trong câu "Practical advice: more important than the tool is that the whole project — ideally the whole organization — follows ONE notation convention, and everyone who must review or use the models knows how to interpret them.", từ "notation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practical advice: more important than the tool is that the whole project — ideally the whole organization — follows ONE notation convention, and everyone who must review or use the models knows how to interpret them.", what does "notation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: notation /nəʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): hệ ký hiệu. "Notation convention" = quy ước ký hiệu (ví dụ BPMN, UML). Cụm: Big O notation.
items.explanationEn: notation /nəʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a system of symbols. A notation convention is an agreed symbol set like BPMN or UML. Phrase: Big O notation.

items.question: Trong câu "Practical advice: more important than the tool is that the whole project — ideally the whole organization — follows ONE notation convention, and everyone who must review or use the models knows how to interpret them.", từ "convention" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practical advice: more important than the tool is that the whole project — ideally the whole organization — follows ONE notation convention, and everyone who must review or use the models knows how to interpret them.", what does "convention" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: convention /kənˈven.ʃən/ (danh từ): quy ước chung. "Follow one convention" = theo một quy ước thống nhất. Cụm: naming convention (quy ước đặt tên).
items.explanationEn: convention /kənˈven.ʃən/ (noun): an agreed standard. "Follow one convention" means sticking to one agreed standard. Phrase: naming convention.

items.question: Trong câu "Practical advice: more important than the tool is that the whole project — ideally the whole organization — follows ONE notation convention, and everyone who must review or use the models knows how to interpret them.", từ "interpret" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practical advice: more important than the tool is that the whole project — ideally the whole organization — follows ONE notation convention, and everyone who must review or use the models knows how to interpret them.", what does "interpret" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: interpret /ɪnˈtɜː.prɪt/ (động từ): hiểu, diễn giải. "Know how to interpret the models" = biết cách đọc hiểu mô hình. Danh từ: interpretation.
items.explanationEn: interpret /ɪnˈtɜː.prɪt/ (verb): to understand the meaning of. "Know how to interpret the models" means being able to read them. Noun: interpretation.

items.question: Trong câu "Practical advice: more important than the tool is that the whole project — ideally the whole organization — follows ONE notation convention, and everyone who must review or use the models knows how to interpret them.", từ "ideally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Practical advice: more important than the tool is that the whole project — ideally the whole organization — follows ONE notation convention, and everyone who must review or use the models knows how to interpret them.", what does "ideally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: ideally /aɪˈdɪə.li/ (trạng từ): lý tưởng nhất là. "Ideally the whole organization" = tốt nhất là cả tổ chức. Tính từ: ideal.
items.explanationEn: ideally /aɪˈdɪə.li/ (adverb): in the best case. "Ideally the whole organization" means that would be best. Adjective: ideal.

items.question: Trong câu "The best choice for a BA — the crudeness makes reviewers comment on structure rather than colour", từ "crudeness" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The best choice for a BA — the crudeness makes reviewers comment on structure rather than colour", what does "crudeness" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: crudeness /ˈkruːd.nəs/ (danh từ): sự thô sơ. Vẻ thô sơ của wireframe khiến người review góp ý cấu trúc thay vì màu sắc. Tính từ: crude (thô, dầu thô = crude oil).
items.explanationEn: crudeness /ˈkruːd.nəs/ (noun): a rough, unpolished quality. A wireframe's crudeness steers reviewers to structure, not colour. Adjective: crude (as in crude oil).

items.question: Trong câu "The designer works in Figma; the BA reviews it against the requirements and leaves comments right where the problem is", từ "against" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The designer works in Figma; the BA reviews it against the requirements and leaves comments right where the problem is", what does "against" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: against /əˈɡenst/ (giới từ): đối chiếu với. "Review X against the requirements" = đối chiếu X với yêu cầu. Cụm: check against, test against.
items.explanationEn: against /əˈɡenst/ (preposition): in comparison with. "Review X against the requirements" means compare it with them. Also: check against, test against.

items.question: Trong câu "Repeating the key principle: whenever you present a wireframe, state clearly that it is a sketch of structure and flow, not the final design.", từ "sketch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Repeating the key principle: whenever you present a wireframe, state clearly that it is a sketch of structure and flow, not the final design.", what does "sketch" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: sketch /sketʃ/ (danh từ): bản phác thảo. Wireframe là "a sketch of structure and flow" — bản phác cấu trúc và luồng, không phải thiết kế cuối.
items.explanationEn: sketch /sketʃ/ (noun): a rough drawing. A wireframe is a sketch of structure and flow, not the final design.

items.question: Trong câu "Repeating the key principle: whenever you present a wireframe, state clearly that it is a sketch of structure and flow, not the final design.", từ "state" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Repeating the key principle: whenever you present a wireframe, state clearly that it is a sketch of structure and flow, not the final design.", what does "state" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (động từ): nêu rõ, tuyên bố. "State clearly that..." = nói rõ rằng. Danh từ: statement; "state" (danh từ) còn là trạng thái, tiểu bang.
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (verb): to say clearly. "State clearly that..." means say it explicitly. Noun: statement; as a noun, state also means condition or region.

items.question: Trong câu "AI is now part of the BA toolkit, but how you use it decides its value.", từ "toolkit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "AI is now part of the BA toolkit, but how you use it decides its value.", what does "toolkit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: toolkit /ˈtuːl.kɪt/ (danh từ): bộ công cụ. "The BA toolkit" = tập hợp công cụ, kỹ năng một BA dùng hằng ngày.
items.explanationEn: toolkit /ˈtuːl.kɪt/ (noun): a set of tools. "The BA toolkit" is the set of tools and skills a BA uses daily.

items.question: Trong câu "Generating test cases from acceptance criteria, especially boundary and exception cases.", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Generating test cases from acceptance criteria, especially boundary and exception cases.", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (danh từ): giá trị biên. "Boundary cases" = trường hợp biên (ngay tại giới hạn, ví dụ 0, max). Cụm: boundary value analysis.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (noun): a limit value. "Boundary cases" sit right at a limit, like 0 or the max. Phrase: boundary value analysis.

items.question: Trong câu "Generating test cases from acceptance criteria, especially boundary and exception cases.", từ "exception" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Generating test cases from acceptance criteria, especially boundary and exception cases.", what does "exception" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: exception /ɪkˈsep.ʃən/ (danh từ): trường hợp ngoại lệ. "Exception cases" = các tình huống ngoại lệ, lệch luồng chính. Cụm: with the exception of (ngoại trừ).
items.explanationEn: exception /ɪkˈsep.ʃən/ (noun): an unusual case. "Exception cases" are situations off the main flow. Phrase: with the exception of.

items.question: Trong câu "Hallucination — never put AI-sourced information into a document unverified, especially numbers and legal requirements.", từ "hallucination" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hallucination — never put AI-sourced information into a document unverified, especially numbers and legal requirements.", what does "hallucination" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: hallucination /həˌluː.sɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): thông tin AI bịa ra. Trong AI, "hallucination" là khi mô hình tự tin đưa ra thông tin sai. Nghĩa gốc: ảo giác.
items.explanationEn: hallucination /həˌluː.sɪˈneɪ.ʃən/ (noun): made-up AI output. In AI, a hallucination is confident but false output. Original sense: seeing things that aren't there.

items.question: Trong câu "Hallucination — never put AI-sourced information into a document unverified, especially numbers and legal requirements.", từ "unverified" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hallucination — never put AI-sourced information into a document unverified, especially numbers and legal requirements.", what does "unverified" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unverified /ʌnˈver.ɪ.faɪd/ (tính từ): chưa được kiểm chứng. Không đưa thông tin từ AI vào tài liệu khi còn "unverified". Động từ: verify.
items.explanationEn: unverified /ʌnˈver.ɪ.faɪd/ (adjective): not yet checked. Never put AI output into a document while it is unverified. Verb: verify.

items.question: Trong câu "Data leakage — pasting requirements or customer data into a public tool can breach confidentiality agreements.", từ "leakage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data leakage — pasting requirements or customer data into a public tool can breach confidentiality agreements.", what does "leakage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: leakage /ˈliː.kɪdʒ/ (danh từ): sự rò rỉ. "Data leakage" = rò rỉ dữ liệu ra ngoài. Động từ: leak (rò, làm lộ).
items.explanationEn: leakage /ˈliː.kɪdʒ/ (noun): an escape of something. "Data leakage" means data escaping to outsiders. Verb: leak.

items.question: Trong câu "Data leakage — pasting requirements or customer data into a public tool can breach confidentiality agreements.", từ "breach" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data leakage — pasting requirements or customer data into a public tool can breach confidentiality agreements.", what does "breach" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to break a rule or deal
items.explanation: breach /briːtʃ/ (động từ): vi phạm. "Breach an agreement" = vi phạm thỏa thuận. Danh từ: a data breach (vụ lộ dữ liệu).
items.explanationEn: breach /briːtʃ/ (verb): to break a rule or deal. "Breach an agreement" means breaking it. Noun: a data breach.

items.question: Trong câu "Data leakage — pasting requirements or customer data into a public tool can breach confidentiality agreements.", từ "confidentiality" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Data leakage — pasting requirements or customer data into a public tool can breach confidentiality agreements.", what does "confidentiality" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: confidentiality /ˌkɒn.fɪ.den.ʃiˈæl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính bảo mật. "Confidentiality agreement" = thỏa thuận bảo mật (NDA). Tính từ: confidential. Đừng nhầm với confidence (tự tin).
items.explanationEn: confidentiality /ˌkɒn.fɪ.den.ʃiˈæl.ə.ti/ (noun): keeping information private. A confidentiality agreement is an NDA. Adjective: confidential. Not the same as confidence.

items.question: Trong câu "Know your company's policy before using one.", từ "policy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Know your company's policy before using one.", what does "policy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: policy /ˈpɒl.ə.si/ (danh từ): chính sách, quy định. "Company policy" = quy định của công ty. Nghĩa khác: insurance policy (hợp đồng bảo hiểm).
items.explanationEn: policy /ˈpɒl.ə.si/ (noun): a set of official rules. "Company policy" means its official rules. Other sense: an insurance policy.

items.question: Trong câu "Loss of thinking depth — for the most important parts, think it through yourself first, then ask AI to compare.", từ "think through" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Loss of thinking depth — for the most important parts, think it through yourself first, then ask AI to compare.", what does "think through" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: think through /θɪŋk θruː/ (cụm từ): suy nghĩ thấu đáo. "Think it through yourself first" = tự suy nghĩ kỹ trước, rồi mới hỏi AI để so sánh.
items.explanationEn: think through /θɪŋk θruː/ (phrase): to consider carefully. "Think it through yourself first" means reasoning fully before asking AI.

items.question: Trong câu "The most effective use: treat AI as an always-available reviewer, not a ghostwriter.", từ "treat" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most effective use: treat AI as an always-available reviewer, not a ghostwriter.", what does "treat" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: treat /triːt/ (động từ): coi như, đối xử như. "Treat AI as a reviewer" = coi AI như người review. Cấu trúc: treat A as B.
items.explanationEn: treat /triːt/ (verb): to regard as. "Treat AI as a reviewer" means regard it that way. Pattern: treat A as B.

items.question: Trong câu "The most effective use: treat AI as an always-available reviewer, not a ghostwriter.", từ "ghostwriter" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most effective use: treat AI as an always-available reviewer, not a ghostwriter.", what does "ghostwriter" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ghostwriter /ˈɡəʊstˌraɪ.tər/ (danh từ): người viết thuê hộ. "Not a ghostwriter" = đừng để AI viết thay bạn; hãy dùng nó để soát lỗi.
items.explanationEn: ghostwriter /ˈɡəʊstˌraɪ.tər/ (noun): someone who writes for another. "Not a ghostwriter" means don't let AI write for you; use it to check your work.

items.question: Trong câu "The strongest prompt is usually asking it to find faults in what you already wrote.", từ "prompt" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The strongest prompt is usually asking it to find faults in what you already wrote.", what does "prompt" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: prompt /prɒmpt/ (danh từ): câu lệnh cho AI. "Prompt" = câu yêu cầu nhập cho mô hình AI. Tính từ "prompt" = nhanh chóng (a prompt reply).
items.explanationEn: prompt /prɒmpt/ (noun): an instruction given to AI. A prompt is the instruction you give an AI model. As an adjective, prompt means quick.

items.question: Trong câu "If you are starting out and unsure what to learn first, this is a sensible order:", từ "start out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you are starting out and unsure what to learn first, this is a sensible order:", what does "start out" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to set off on a trip
items.explanation: start out /stɑːt aʊt/ (cụm từ): mới vào nghề. "If you are starting out" = nếu bạn mới bắt đầu (nghề BA). Nghĩa khác: start out on a journey (khởi hành).
items.explanationEn: start out /stɑːt aʊt/ (phrase): to begin a career. "If you are starting out" means new to the field. Other sense: starting out on a journey.

items.question: Trong câu "If you are starting out and unsure what to learn first, this is a sensible order:", từ "sensible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you are starting out and unsure what to learn first, this is a sensible order:", what does "sensible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sensible /ˈsen.sə.bəl/ (tính từ): hợp lý. "A sensible order" = thứ tự hợp lý. Bẫy: sensible ≠ sensitive (nhạy cảm).
items.explanationEn: sensible /ˈsen.sə.bəl/ (adjective): reasonable. "A sensible order" is a reasonable one. Trap: sensible is not sensitive.

items.question: Trong câu "A work tracker — Jira or equivalent.", từ "equivalent" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A work tracker — Jira or equivalent.", what does "equivalent" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: equivalent /ɪˈkwɪv.əl.ənt/ (danh từ): thứ tương đương. "Jira or equivalent" = Jira hoặc công cụ tương đương. Cụm: the equivalent of.
items.explanationEn: equivalent /ɪˈkwɪv.əl.ənt/ (noun): something equal in function. "Jira or equivalent" means Jira or a tool that does the same job. Phrase: the equivalent of.

items.question: Trong câu "A documentation tool — Confluence, a wiki, or even a clearly structured folder.", từ "structured" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A documentation tool — Confluence, a wiki, or even a clearly structured folder.", what does "structured" (adjective) mean?
options: được sắp xếp có cấu trúc
items.explanation: structured /ˈstrʌk.tʃəd/ (tính từ): được sắp xếp có cấu trúc. "A clearly structured folder" = thư mục sắp xếp rõ ràng. Cụm: structured data (dữ liệu có cấu trúc).
items.explanationEn: structured /ˈstrʌk.tʃəd/ (adjective): organized in a clear way. "A clearly structured folder" is well organized. Phrase: structured data.

items.question: Trong câu "A spreadsheet — still the strongest tool for quick data analysis, simple traceability matrices, and checklists.", từ "traceability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A spreadsheet — still the strongest tool for quick data analysis, simple traceability matrices, and checklists.", what does "traceability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: traceability /ˌtreɪ.səˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): khả năng truy vết. "Traceability matrix" = ma trận truy vết yêu cầu ↔ thiết kế ↔ test. Động từ: trace.
items.explanationEn: traceability /ˌtreɪ.səˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): the ability to follow links. A traceability matrix links requirements to design and tests. Verb: trace.

items.question: Trong câu "A spreadsheet — still the strongest tool for quick data analysis, simple traceability matrices, and checklists.", từ "checklist" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A spreadsheet — still the strongest tool for quick data analysis, simple traceability matrices, and checklists.", what does "checklist" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a list of items to tick off
items.explanation: checklist /ˈtʃek.lɪst/ (danh từ): danh sách kiểm tra. "Checklist" = danh sách việc cần đánh dấu từng mục; bảng tính rất hợp để làm checklist.
items.explanationEn: checklist /ˈtʃek.lɪst/ (noun): a list of items to tick off. A checklist is ticked off item by item; spreadsheets suit them well.

items.question: Trong câu "SQL — to query data yourself and test assumptions without waiting on anyone.", từ "query" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "SQL — to query data yourself and test assumptions without waiting on anyone.", what does "query" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: query /ˈkwɪə.ri/ (động từ): truy vấn (dữ liệu). "Query data yourself" = tự truy vấn dữ liệu bằng SQL. Nghĩa khác: query a bill (thắc mắc về hóa đơn).
items.explanationEn: query /ˈkwɪə.ri/ (verb): to request data from. "Query data yourself" means pulling it with SQL. Other sense: to query (question) a bill.

items.question: Trong câu "SQL — to query data yourself and test assumptions without waiting on anyone.", từ "wait on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "SQL — to query data yourself and test assumptions without waiting on anyone.", what does "wait on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: wait on /weɪt ɒn/ (cụm từ): phải chờ vào ai. "Without waiting on anyone" = không phải chờ ai làm hộ. Nghĩa khác: wait on customers (phục vụ khách).
items.explanationEn: wait on /weɪt ɒn/ (phrase): to depend on someone first. "Without waiting on anyone" means not depending on others. Other sense: to wait on customers.

items.question: Trong câu "A low-fidelity wireframing tool.", từ "low-fidelity" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A low-fidelity wireframing tool.", what does "low-fidelity" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: low-fidelity /ˌləʊ.fɪˈdel.ə.ti/ (tính từ): độ chi tiết thấp. "Low-fidelity" (lo-fi) = bản phác đơn giản, ít chi tiết. Trái nghĩa: high-fidelity (hi-fi).
items.explanationEn: low-fidelity /ˌləʊ.fɪˈdel.ə.ti/ (adjective): rough and basic. Low-fidelity (lo-fi) means simple and rough. Opposite: high-fidelity (hi-fi).

items.question: Trong câu "A collaborative whiteboard for remote workshops.", từ "collaborative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A collaborative whiteboard for remote workshops.", what does "collaborative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: collaborative /kəˈlæb.ər.ə.tɪv/ (tính từ): để cộng tác cùng nhau. "Collaborative whiteboard" = bảng trắng nhiều người cùng thao tác. Động từ: collaborate.
items.explanationEn: collaborative /kəˈlæb.ər.ə.tɪv/ (adjective): used for working together. A collaborative whiteboard lets many people work on it at once. Verb: collaborate.

items.question: Trong câu "A collaborative whiteboard for remote workshops.", từ "remote" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A collaborative whiteboard for remote workshops.", what does "remote" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: remote /rɪˈməʊt/ (tính từ): trực tuyến từ xa. "Remote workshop" = buổi workshop từ xa. Cụm: remote work, a remote chance (khả năng rất nhỏ).
items.explanationEn: remote /rɪˈməʊt/ (adjective): done from different places. A remote workshop runs online. Phrases: remote work, a remote chance.

items.question: Trong câu "Tools amplify existing capability — they do not create new capability.", từ "amplify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tools amplify existing capability — they do not create new capability.", what does "amplify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: amplify /ˈæm.plɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): khuếch đại. "Tools amplify capability" = công cụ khuếch đại năng lực sẵn có, không tạo ra năng lực mới. Danh từ: amplifier (bộ khuếch đại).
items.explanationEn: amplify /ˈæm.plɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to make stronger. "Tools amplify capability" means they magnify what exists. Noun: amplifier.

items.question: Trong câu "Tools amplify existing capability — they do not create new capability.", từ "capability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tools amplify existing capability — they do not create new capability.", what does "capability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): năng lực. "Existing capability" = năng lực sẵn có. Đừng nhầm với capacity (sức chứa, công suất).
items.explanationEn: capability /ˌkeɪ.pəˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): the ability to do something. "Existing capability" is ability you already have. Don't confuse it with capacity.

items.question: Trong câu "Tools do NOT give you good requirements — weak analysis just yields bad requirements organized attractively.", từ "yield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tools do NOT give you good requirements — weak analysis just yields bad requirements organized attractively.", what does "yield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: yield /jiːld/ (động từ): tạo ra, đem lại. "Weak analysis yields bad requirements" = phân tích yếu sinh ra yêu cầu tệ. Nghĩa khác: yield sign (biển nhường đường).
items.explanationEn: yield /jiːld/ (verb): to produce a result. "Weak analysis yields bad requirements" means it produces them. Other sense: a yield (give-way) sign.

items.question: Trong câu "The ability to ask the right question outweighs any tool — tools amplify rather than create capability.", từ "outweigh" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The ability to ask the right question outweighs any tool — tools amplify rather than create capability.", what does "outweigh" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: outweigh /ˌaʊtˈweɪ/ (động từ): quan trọng hơn. "X outweighs Y" = X có giá trị/quan trọng hơn Y. Cụm: the benefits outweigh the costs.
items.explanationEn: outweigh /ˌaʊtˈweɪ/ (verb): to matter more than. "X outweighs Y" means X matters more. Phrase: the benefits outweigh the costs.

items.question: Trong câu "Choose tools by actual adoption and integration, not by feature list.", từ "adoption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Choose tools by actual adoption and integration, not by feature list.", what does "adoption" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: how widely something is taken up
items.explanation: adoption /əˈdɒp.ʃən/ (danh từ): mức độ được sử dụng. "Actual adoption" = mức độ nhóm thực sự dùng công cụ. Cụm: user adoption, adoption rate.
items.explanationEn: adoption /əˈdɒp.ʃən/ (noun): how widely something is taken up. "Actual adoption" is how much the team really uses a tool. Phrases: user adoption, adoption rate.

items.question: Trong câu "Jira and Confluence divide by information lifespan: short-lived work items versus long-lived organizational knowledge.", từ "lifespan" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Jira and Confluence divide by information lifespan: short-lived work items versus long-lived organizational knowledge.", what does "lifespan" (noun) mean?
options: vòng đời, thời gian tồn tại
items.explanation: lifespan /ˈlaɪf.spæn/ (danh từ): vòng đời, thời gian tồn tại. "Information lifespan" = thông tin tồn tại bao lâu; là tiêu chí chia Jira và Confluence.
items.explanationEn: lifespan /ˈlaɪf.spæn/ (noun): how long something lasts. "Information lifespan" — how long information stays relevant — divides Jira from Confluence.

items.question: Trong câu "Jira and Confluence divide by information lifespan: short-lived work items versus long-lived organizational knowledge.", từ "versus" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Jira and Confluence divide by information lifespan: short-lived work items versus long-lived organizational knowledge.", what does "versus" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: versus /ˈvɜː.səs/ (giới từ): so với, đối lập với. "A versus B" (viết tắt vs.) = A so với B, đối lập hai thứ.
items.explanationEn: versus /ˈvɜː.səs/ (preposition): as opposed to. "A versus B" (abbreviated vs.) contrasts two things.

items.question: Trong câu "Keep diagrams and wireframes low-fidelity early to attract feedback about structure.", từ "attract" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Keep diagrams and wireframes low-fidelity early to attract feedback about structure.", what does "attract" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: attract /əˈtrækt/ (động từ): thu hút. "Attract feedback" = thu hút góp ý. Tính từ: attractive; danh từ: attraction.
items.explanationEn: attract /əˈtrækt/ (verb): to draw in. "Attract feedback" means draw comments in. Adjective: attractive; noun: attraction.
